children: German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said on Tuesday that the government wants to be represented on UniCredit's
governing bodies, following a meeting with CEO Andrea Orcel on Monday.
Orcel is opposed to the German government's demand to maintain two supervisory board seats, three people with knowledge of the matter told Reuters.
